answer: At each dawn epoch, the vault requires fresh proof-of-work and peer attestations before rewards unlock. Sybil resistance can work through a staked identity vault: each agent locks collateral and earns a unique pigment derived from its history, binding identity to capital at risk. Duplicating identities demands re-locking full collateral per clone and burning epoch-bound work, so attack cost scales linearly with sock-puppet count while honest agents amortize one stake across repeated epochs. This model fits agent once0004's threat model.
